title: Drip, Drop, the Garden Wakes
passage_text:
Drip, drop, the garden wakes.
Drip, drop, the green grass grows.
Bees buzz by the big blue pot.
Drip, drop, the garden wakes.

Sam and I dig in the dirt.
We plant six small seeds in a row.
Worms wiggle, wiggle, wiggle down.
Drip, drop, the garden wakes.

Red roses rise up to the sun.
Tall, tall sunflowers nod hello.
We water, wait, and watch them grow.
Drip, drop, the garden wakes.

Night comes soft and slow.
The moon says, "Rest now, seeds."
Tomorrow we will dig some more.
Drip, drop, the garden wakes.

skill_instances.explanation: This line repeats at the end of every stanza.

skill_instances.quote: Bees buzz by the big blue pot.
skill_instances.explanation: Alliteration: bees, buzz, by, big and blue all start with b.
Wiggle repeats, and worms and wiggle both start with w.
Alliteration: red, roses and rise all start with r.

skill_instances.quote: We water, wait, and watch them grow.
skill_instances.explanation: Alliteration: water, wait and watch all start with w.

protagonist.notes: child speaker gardening with a friend, Sam

setting: a backyard garden on a rainy spring day

lesson_hooks.hook_question: What sounds does rain make in a garden?
lesson_hooks.i_do: Model the repeated line 'Drip, drop, the garden wakes.' because it comes back four times.
lesson_hooks.we_do: Students find the b sounds in 'Bees buzz by the big blue pot.'
lesson_hooks.you_do_question: Which line repeats at the end of every stanza?
